nearby.title: Ubani oseduze nawe

nearby.describeHint: Sizobonisa umsebenzi wakho kubantu abaseduze abangawuthatha, wena uzokhetha emananini abo.

job.title: Umsebenzi wakho
job.waitingForProvider: Kulindwe {{name}} ukuthi aqinisekise. Inombolo nekheli kuyavuleka uma eqinisekisa.
job.noQuotesBody: Abantu abaseduze bangabona umsebenzi wakho. Amanani abo azoboniswa lapha lapho efika.
job.acceptedBody: Qinisekisa ukuze ubone ikheli nezinombolo zocingo, noma ungaqhubeki uma ungekhe ukwazi wenza umsebenzi.
job.cancelConfirm: Khansela lo msebenzi? Lokhu ngeke kungahlaziywa.

contact.lockedBody: Izinombolo zocingo nekheli kuvuleka uma umsebenzi eqinisekisa umsebenzi.

chat.privacyNote: Izinombolo namakheli kufihliwe kuze kuqinisekiswe umsebenzi.
chat.pickThreadBody: Umuntu ngamunye onikeze inani unengxoxo yakhe. Vula eyodwa kusuka enanini labo ekhasini lomsebenzi wakho.

feed.title: Imisebenzi eseduze nawe

feed.acceptedNote: Ikhasimende lamukele inani lakho. Vula umsebenzi ukuqinisekisa.
feed.emptyBody: Imisebenzi yohlobo lwakho ibonakala lapha lapho amakhasimende efaka.

verifyId.title: Hlola i-ID yakho

safety.title: Ukuphepha
safety.intro: Nguwe kuphela obona lokhu. Omunye umuntu akatshelwa.
safety.panicConfirmBody: Sizothumela umlayezo kumuntu omethembayo simtshele ukuthi ukuphi.
safety.panicSentTo: Isexwayiso sithunyelwe ku-{{name}} kanye nendawo okuyo.
safety.panicSentNoLocation: Isexwayiso sithunyelwe ku-{{name}}. Indawo okuyo ibingatholakali.
safety.panicNoContact: Isexwayiso silotshiwe. Engeza umuntu omethembayo ukuze atshelwe ngokuzayo.
safety.panicNotSent: Asikwazanga ukuthumela umlayezo ku-{{name}}. Thumela isexwayiso nge-WhatsApp, noma ushayele ukuze uthole usizo ngezansi.
safety.timerBody: Uma ungacindezeli ethi “Ngiphephile” ngesikhathi, sizothumela umlayezo kumuntu omethembayo.
safety.timerMissed: Isikhathi siphelile, ngakho sithumele umlayezo kumuntu omethembayo.
safety.timerMissedNoContact: Isikhathi siphelile. Engeza umuntu omethembayo ukuze atshelwe ngokuzayo.
safety.timerMissedNotSent: Isikhathi siphelile, kodwa asikwazanga ukuthumela umlayezo kumuntu omethembayo. Wuthumele nge-WhatsApp.
safety.contactNone: Engeza umuntu esingamthumelela umlayezo uma udinga usizo.
